page.overview:
Who is Candy Mane?

Candy Mane is the placeholder name of a female Earth pony with an apricot color coat, light grayish-rose and moderate-cerise wavy-streaked mane, and moderate cerise eyes. She has a cutie mark of a pair of pony silhouettes, a row of pink bubbles, or a bunch of grapes and a strawberry, this however is absent in most of her appearances.__TOC__

In late April 2011, layout artist "FlashinthePan" was asked regarding this pony "Hey, FitP, I noticed an adult pony in the background once. It looks suspiciously like an adult scootaloo, Is this just a coincidence or did the character design of scoots come from this background pony" and answered "Gotta be a coincidence. But I'm not sure where she comes from, since she's not in the general file for incidental ponies (that I remember). She must be elsewhere, like 'incidental_party_pony' or something."

She has the same color scheme as Orange Swirl, the same coat and mane colors as Swan Song, and the same tail style as Derpy, Sunshower Raindrops, Blue Buck, Tropical Storm, High Spirits, and other ponies. Her cutie mark in Filli Vanilli, Inspiration Manifestation, and The One Where Pinkie Pie Knows is the same as on Sisterhooves Social flyers, her cutie mark in The Mysterious Mare Do Well is the same as that of S05E25 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #2, and her cutie mark in Leap of Faith is the same as that of Strawberry Sunrise.

Candy Mane makes her first appearance in Friendship is Magic, part 1 during the Summer Sun Celebration, shortly before Nightmare Moon arrives and also during her episode-closing speech (she makes an identical appearance in the previous episode recap in part 2). In The Ticket Master, she briefly appears in Rainbow Dash's fantasy of the Grand Galloping Gala. In Boast Busters, she appears at regular points during Trixie's magic show and near the end of the episode following Twilight Sparkle's "vanquishing" of the ursa major.
